title: Bounded lisse cohomology of the inverse finite scalar realization
statement: Let X and Y be schemes, g:Y→X a morphism, d an adic coefficient datum on A [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], U an object of Y_proet, and n a natural number. Let B_n = lisseTowerEtaleRing(d,n), and let F = lisseTowerFixedRealization(U.hom ≫ g,d,n) be the explicit finite scalar equivalence [def-weil-pbc-lisse-tower-etale-descent-data]. Let N be a derived module over the n-th actual adic coefficient sheaf on X [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower], and E a bounded derived B_n-module whose cohomology modules are finitely generated [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Suppose a covering sieve T on U is supplied and every arrow w:W→U in T has an isomorphism constantAdicQuotientRealization(W.hom ≫ g,d,n)(E) ≅ adicTowerPullback(W.hom ≫ g)(N), using the actual constant realization [lem-weil-pbc-constant-adic-quotient-scalar-comparison]. Define K = F.inverse(adicTowerPullback(U.hom ≫ g)(N)). Then K is bounded and, for every integer q, H^q(K) is lisse as a fixed B_n-module sheaf on U.left_proet: it is locally constant and each of its fixed geometric module stalks is finite, in the predicate of [lem-sf-proetale-locally-constant-origin]. No etale complex D or derived etale origin is part of this assertion.

source.place: lemma-compare-locally-constant (Tag 099Y), local constant model calculation; sites-modules.tex lemma-exactness-pushforward-pullback (Tag 03DC) and lemma-constant-exact (Tag 093J).

proof.text: Put B=lisseTowerEtaleRing(d,n), F=lisseTowerFixedRealization(U.hom followed by g,d,n), and K=F.inverse of the actual pullback. The equivalence counit identifies F(K) with that actual pullback. By ProEt.mem_topology_iff choose a covering presieve P contained in the supplied model sieve T, and write P as ofArrows(W,w). ProEt.mem_precoverage_iff identifies the underlying scheme arrows w_i.left as a proetalePrecoverage of U.left. Thus the full fpqc covering condition, including empty covers, is retained without choosing geometric points or affine refinements.

On each member w_i put a=w_i.left and b=U.hom followed by g. The equation w_i.w gives a followed by b = W_i.hom followed by g. Specialize lisseTower_localized_constants_model to the maps a and id of W_i.left, removing the identity inverse image by its derived identity comparison. This identifies the fixed realization of localProEtaleComparison(a,B)(normalizationConstant(E)) with the supplied constantAdicQuotientRealization model.

Localize the ordinary fixed-realization pullback square using lisseTowerFixedRealizationIso and mapDerivedCategorySquareIso. Apply it to K and then map the counit through ordinary module pullback. Use proEtaleCanonicalPullbackComposition_existsUnique to identify the composite actual pullback with the actual pullback along a followed by b. Its coefficient compatibility follows because the chosen comparison along a is the inverse ring inverse-image compositor, so the compositor and its inverse cancel. Rewrite along w_i.w, paste with the supplied model isomorphism and the inverse comparison from the preceding step, and apply the fully faithful fixed realization preimageIso. This gives an isomorphism from the derived fixed-coefficient pullback of K to localProEtaleComparison(a,B)(normalizationConstant(E)).

For every q apply homology to the preceding isomorphism. The proved mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso for inverse image, comparison inverse image and exact constants moves homology through all three functors. ConstantSheafsheafPullbackIso identifies constants after comparison and after inverse image with constants on W_i.left. Consequently the ordinary inverse image of H^q(K) is the constant sheaf with value H^q(E). This explicitly constructs the cohomology-model isomorphisms, rather than assuming a comparison or any compatibility between local markings.

Keep the supplied bounded window [a,b]. For q outside it, exact constants carry the zero module H^q(E) to zero, so every inverse image of H^q(K) is zero. The source-library upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction identifies these with ordinary localization restrictions. The proved source-library isIso_of_isIso_localizationRestriction applied to the zero map H^q(K) to zero makes that map invertible globally, hence H^q(K) is zero. This argument uses covering membership, not just joint surjectivity, and applies also when U.left and the covering are empty.

For each q use the finite coefficient ring B and the supplied Module.Finite hypothesis to obtain Finite H^q(E) by Module.finite_of_finite. The same scheme covering and the cohomology-model isomorphisms satisfy finiteModels_over and finite_geometricStalk_of_finite_models. The first gives precisely the localized constant models in IsLocallyConstantProEtaleFixedModuleSheaf; the second gives finiteness at every fixed geometric point. Their conjunction is IsLisseProEtaleFixedModuleSheaf. No etale derived origin, overlap equation, or extra hypothesis is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem lisse_finite_level_inverse_realization_cohomology
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (U : Y.ProEt) (n : ℕ)
    (N : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))))
    (E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)))
    (hbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj E))
    (hfinite : ∀ q : ℤ, Module.Finite (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)) q).obj E))
    (hmodels : ∃ T : Sieve U, T ∈ ProEt.topology Y U ∧
      ∀ (W : Y.ProEt) (w : W ⟶ U), T w →
        Nonempty ((constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d n).obj E ≅
          (adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g)
            ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj N)) :
    let K := (lisseTowerFixedRealization (U.hom ≫ g) d n).asEquivalence.inverse.obj
      ((adicTowerPullback (U.hom ≫ g) ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj N)
    (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K)) ∧
      (∀ q : ℤ, IsLisseProEtaleFixedModuleSheaf U.left (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K))
